{
 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Robust Linear Models"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:18.842365Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:18.841871Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:19.573311Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:19.568859Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:19.576725Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:19.576486Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.735394Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.732870Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation\n",
    "\n",
    "Load data:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.738804Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.738496Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.750172Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.749860Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "data = sm.datasets.stackloss.load()\n",
    "data.exog = sm.add_constant(data.exog)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with the (default) median absolute deviation scaling"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.752465Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.752223Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.770826Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.770466Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.791899\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.111005\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.302930\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.128650\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "                    Robust Linear Model Regression Results                    \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   No. Observations:                   21\n",
      "Model:                            RLM   Df Residuals:                       17\n",
      "Method:                          IRLS   Df Model:                            3\n",
      "Norm:                          HuberT                                         \n",
      "Scale Est.:                       mad                                         \n",
      "Cov Type:                          H1                                         \n",
      "Date:                Tue, 24 Nov 2026                                         \n",
      "Time:                        22:10:21                                         \n",
      "No. Iterations:                    19                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          z      P>|z|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "var_0        -41.0265      9.792     -4.190      0.000     -60.218     -21.835\n",
      "var_1          0.8294      0.111      7.472      0.000       0.612       1.047\n",
      "var_2          0.9261      0.303      3.057      0.002       0.332       1.520\n",
      "var_3         -0.1278      0.129     -0.994      0.320      -0.380       0.124\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "If the model instance has been used for another fit with different fit parameters, then the fit options might not be the correct ones anymore .\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "huber_t = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT())\n",
    "hub_results = huber_t.fit()\n",
    "print(hub_results.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results.bse)\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    hub_results.summary(\n",
    "        yname=\"y\", xname=[f\"var_{i}\" for i in range(len(hub_results.params))]\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with 'H2' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.774904Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.774686Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.786153Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.785747Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.089504\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.119460\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.322355\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.117963\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "hub_results2 = huber_t.fit(cov=\"H2\")\n",
    "print(hub_results2.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Andrew's Wave norm with Huber's Proposal 2 scaling and 'H3' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.789854Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.789652Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.816519Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.814045Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Parameters:  const       -40.881796\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.792761\n",
      "WATERTEMP     1.048576\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.133609\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "andrew_mod = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.AndrewWave())\n",
    "andrew_results = andrew_mod.fit(scale_est=sm.robust.scale.HuberScale(), cov=\"H3\")\n",
    "print(\"Parameters: \", andrew_results.params)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "See ``help(sm.RLM.fit)`` for more options and ``module sm.robust.scale`` for scale options\n",
    "\n",
    "## Comparing OLS and RLM\n",
    "\n",
    "Artificial data with outliers:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.819903Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.819688Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.825372Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.824960Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "sig = 0.3  # smaller error variance makes OLS<->RLM contrast bigger\n",
    "beta = [5, 0.5, -0.0]\n",
    "y_true2 = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y2 = y_true2 + sig * 1.0 * np.random.normal(size=nsample)\n",
    "y2[[39, 41, 43, 45, 48]] -= 5  # add some outliers (10% of nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 1: quadratic function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Note that the quadratic term in OLS regression will capture outlier effects. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.826835Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.826643Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.831149Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.830821Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.1187823   0.52034067 -0.01334046]\n",
      "[0.46445666 0.07170584 0.00634486]\n",
      "[ 4.78527081  5.04988313  5.31005048  5.56577286  5.81705027  6.06388272\n",
      "  6.3062702   6.54421271  6.77771026  7.00676283  7.23137044  7.45153308\n",
      "  7.66725075  7.87852346  8.08535119  8.28773396  8.48567176  8.6791646\n",
      "  8.86821246  9.05281536  9.23297329  9.40868625  9.57995425  9.74677728\n",
      "  9.90915534 10.06708843 10.22057655 10.36961971 10.5142179  10.65437112\n",
      " 10.79007937 10.92134265 11.04816097 11.17053432 11.2884627  11.40194612\n",
      " 11.51098456 11.61557804 11.71572655 11.81143009 11.90268867 11.98950228\n",
      " 12.07187092 12.14979459 12.22327329 12.29230703 12.3568958  12.4170396\n",
      " 12.47273843 12.52399229]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res = sm.OLS(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(res.params)\n",
    "print(res.bse)\n",
    "print(res.predict())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.833816Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.833624Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.841584Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.841244Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.06339490e+00  5.01676822e-01 -2.44015047e-03]\n",
      "[0.14198496 0.02192056 0.00193963]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm = sm.RLM(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.845751Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:21.845620Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.169899Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.169556Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f5653c63cb0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))\n",
    "ax = fig.add_subplot(111)\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "pred_ols = res.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 2: linear function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Fit a new OLS model using only the linear term and the constant:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.174806Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.174622Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.184316Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.183979Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.65648449 0.38693607]\n",
      "[0.4012871  0.03457652]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "X2 = X[:, [0, 1]]\n",
    "res2 = sm.OLS(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(res2.params)\n",
    "print(res2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.186700Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.186467Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.197309Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.197005Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.13605207 0.48186063]\n",
      "[0.10938542 0.00942509]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm2 = sm.RLM(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm2.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.200695Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.200473Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.453476Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-24T22:10:22.453015Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "pred_ols = res2.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res2.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm2.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "legend = ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  }
 ],
